    </button>
    <button bindtap="onCancelOriginal" disabled="{{busy}}">

    </button>
  </view>
  <button wx:if="{{state === 'draft' &amp;&amp; management === 'none'}}" data-action="cancel_draft" bindtap="onCommand" disabled="{{busy || pending}}" class="ops-destructive">

  </button>
  <view wx:if="{{loaded &amp;&amp; management !== 'none' &amp;&amp; !pending}}" class="ops-editor">

    <view class="meta ops-field-label">

        <button bindtap="onFindRegions" disabled="{{busy}}">

        <view wx:for="{{regions}}" wx:key="id">

        <view class="meta">

            选择 / 替换
          </button>

            移除
          </button>
          <button wx:if="{{item.configured &amp;&amp; !item.changed}}" data-slot="{{item.slot}}" bindtap="onPreview" disabled="{{busy}}">

          </button>
        </view>
        <view>
          {{upload.message}}
        </view>

        <image wx:if="{{image.src}}" src="{{image.src}}" mode="widthFix" />
      </view>
      <button wx:if="{{state === 'draft'}}" data-action="save" bindtap="onCommand" disabled="{{busy}}" class="ops-primary">
        保存上传准备
      </button>
      <button wx:if="{{state === 'draft'}}" data-action="publish" bindtap="onCommand" disabled="{{busy || dirty}}" class="ops-primary">
        发布公告
      </button>
      <button wx:if="{{state === 'draft'}}" data-action="cancel_draft" bindtap="onCommand" disabled="{{busy}}" class="ops-destructive">
        取消上传草稿
      </button>
      <button wx:if="{{state === 'active' || state === 'inactive'}}" data-action="update" bindtap="onCommand" disabled="{{busy}}" class="ops-primary">
        保存公告修改
      </button>
      <button wx:if="{{state === 'active'}}" data-action="set_enabled" data-enabled="false" bindtap="onCommand" disabled="{{busy || dirty}}">

      </button>
      <button wx:if="{{state === 'inactive'}}" data-action="set_enabled" data-enabled="true" bindtap="onCommand" disabled="{{busy || dirty}}">

  <button bindtap="onRefresh" disabled="{{busy}}" class="ops-quiet">
